howToApply: Download and fill the application form attached with the notification completely in all respects.
Carry the completed application form to the walk-in interview venue.

title: Nainital Bank Recruitment 2026 – Specialist Officer (SO) Posts
shortInfo: Nainital Bank has announced notification for Specialist Officer (SO) posts. Required qualification: Graduate/Post Graduate degree. Last date to apply: 07-09-26.

vacancyList.postName: IT Officer (Software Developer/API Developer/RPA Developer/ETL Developer/System Administrator/Database Administrator/Network Administrator) in Grade/Scale-I

howToApply: Visit the Bank’s official website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in and navigate to the Career section under the Recruitment tab.
Click on ‘Current Openings’ and then click on ‘APPLY ONLINE’.
Choose ‘Click here for New Registration’ and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID to get a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
Fill in the application form carefully. Use ‘SAVE AND NEXT’ to save progress.
Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm, 20KB–50KB, JPG/JPEG), signature (10KB–20KB), left thumb impression (20KB–50KB), and hand-written declaration (50KB–100KB).
Also capture and upload a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone as instructed.
Preview the entire application form before final submission.
Click ‘COMPLETE REGISTRATION’ after verifying all details.
Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1500/- (including GST) online using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards, Mobile Wallets, or UPI.
After successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the online application form.
A candidate can apply for only one post. In case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.

title: AAI NR Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI NR has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 16-09-26.
howToApply: Visit BOAT’s/RDAT’s web portal: www.nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Register yourself on the concerned portal (NATS/NAPS) prior to applying for apprenticeship training in AAI.
Find establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002(BOAT) / E05200700101(NAPS)) and click on the Apply button.
Complete your profile with all required details including educational qualifications, communication details, and training preferences.
Upload required documents including qualifying degree/provisional certificate in PDF format.
After successful application, the portal will display the message: ‘Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment.’
Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.
No Application Fee is being charged.

title: Local Self Government Rajasthan Recruitment 2026 – Contractual Safai Karmachari Posts
shortInfo: Local Self Government Rajasthan has announced notification for Contractual Safai Karmachari posts. Required qualification: 1 year experience in sanitation/cleaning. Last date to apply: 28-09-26.

vacancyList.postName: Contractual Safai Karmachari (Sanvida Safai Karmachari) - Non-Scheduled Area
Contractual Safai Karmachari (Sanvida Safai Karmachari) - Scheduled Area

howToApply: Visit the department’s online portal at https://lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in/ or SSO portal at https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in and login.
After login, select ‘Recruitment Portal’ available under Citizen Apps (G2C) and click on ‘Apply Now’.
If One Time Registration (OTR) fee has not been paid, first complete OTR by selecting your category (Unreserved/Reserved), disability status, and home state, then pay the registration fee.
After completing OTR, fill the online application form carefully. Information entered during OTR (name, father’s name, date of birth, gender, ID details) cannot be modified.
Capture a live photo during the application process and submit the application.
Fill in the visible mark (drishya chinh) in the online application form.
After submission, an Application ID will be generated. If no Application ID is received, the application has not been submitted successfully.
Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
Applications can also be filled through designated e-Mitra Kiosks / Jan Suvidha Kendras.
Applicants can apply for only ONE Urban Local Body (ULB) out of the 183 advertised. Applying to more than one ULB will result in cancellation of all applications.
